VBO:0201215.summary: Sheepdog covers breeds with different roles around flocks. Border Collies herd livestock, while the Abruzzes and Maremma Shepherd Dog chiefly protects sheep and property; both fall within the FCI sheepdog section.
VBO:0201215.shortDescription: Sheepdogs include flock herders and guardians, whose traditional jobs call for different working methods.
